title: Don't Trust Sneaky Notes
goal: Some pages whisper instructions. Always ask a grown-up first.
mascot_lines: Some webpages hide sneaky words that try to trick helpers into doing weird stuff.
If a helper suddenly acts strange, stop and ask a grown-up.
Real instructions come from YOU, not from a random page on the internet.
When in doubt, slow down — being careful is always smart.
